text: The Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake (NHC) administers the NHCover, a national reinsurance program in New Zealand, funded by levies on insured homeowners. The 2025 expansion of this program, known as the Public Reinsurance Program Expansion, aims to provide comprehensive coverage for natural catastrophe risks beyond earthquakes, as mandated by the Natural Hazards Insurance Act 2023. The program secures large-scale reinsurance capacity from international markets and includes a catastrophe bond to diversify risk and enhance resilience.
